chapters.title: 🛡️ What Is Incident Response?
chapters.description: Discover the world of digital firefighters! Learn what incidents are, why they matter, and meet the IR lifecycle.

chapters.title: 📋 The IR Lifecycle (NIST & SANS)
chapters.description: Deep dive into the four phases: Preparation, Detection & Analysis, Containment/Eradication/Recovery, and Post-Incident.

chapters.title: 🧰 Preparation: Building Your Arsenal
chapters.description: Policies, playbooks, tools, and team structure. How to be ready before the alarm rings.

chapters.title: 🔍 Detection & Analysis
chapters.description: Hunting for evil. SIEM alerts, log analysis, and determining scope of a breach.

chapters.title: ⛔ Containment Strategies
chapters.description: Stop the bleeding. Short-term vs long-term containment, network segmentation, and difficult decisions.

chapters.title: 🧹 Eradication & Recovery
chapters.description: Kicking the attacker out for good and restoring business operations safely.

chapters.title: 📝 Post-Incident Activity
chapters.description: The most skipped step: Lessons Learned. How to improve without blaming.

chapters.title: 🕵️ Digital Forensics Fundamentals
chapters.description: Order of Volatility, Chain of Custody, and preserving evidence without ruining it.

chapters.title: 🌐 Threat Intelligence for IR
chapters.description: Using IOCs, TTPs, and the Cyber Kill Chain to speed up investigations.

chapters.title: 📊 Log Analysis Mastery
chapters.description: Windows Event Logs, Sysmon, and Apache logs. Finding the needle in the haystack.

chapters.title: 🐞 Introduction to Malware Analysis
chapters.description: Static vs Dynamic analysis. Sandboxes and basic reverse engineering concepts.

chapters.title: 📢 Communication & Reporting
chapters.description: Writing the executive summary and the technical report. Legal hold notices.

chapters.title: ⚖️ Legal & Compliance Considerations
chapters.description: Data breach notification laws, GDPR, and working with law enforcement.

chapters.title: 🛠️ IR Tools & Automation
chapters.description: Velociraptor, TheHive, and scripting triage with PowerShell/Python.

chapters.title: 🎮 Tabletop Exercises & Simulation
chapters.description: Testing your plan with walkthrough scenarios. Bringing everything together.
